title: Package registered for the checked signing key
summary: The checked signing key is registered for com.example.test; for an F-Droid APK, confirm that the distributed build uses the same registered key.
steps: Compare AA:BB with the certificate fingerprint of the F-Droid build you checked.
If F-Droid signs the distributed APK with its own key, register that signing key for the package as well.
Re-check the package and certificate pair when the signing key changes.
Use the Android developer verification guides to review package and key registration details.
